scope: Separate continuous market-state classification from operational re-risk permission after the immutable P5.3 V1 architecture failure. No signal retuning, P5.4 gross mapping, production selection or production authorization.

v1_failure_must_remain_visible.rule: V2 may not change any signal definition, threshold, profile, event label, anchor or bucket to remove or relabel this false raw FLAT.

MARKET_STATE.purpose: Continuously classify current market evidence across the full historical path, including after a severe FLAT market classification.

RISK_PERMISSION_LOCK.purpose: Operational control over whether directional risk may actually be re-added after an implemented zero-exposure action.
RISK_PERMISSION_LOCK.research_simulation_rule: P5.3 V2 does not simulate a historical permission-lock path because P5.4 has not yet defined which market states map to actual zero directional exposure. The permission semantics are frozen now so MARKET_STATE recovery can never be misread as live re-entry authorization.

unchanged_rules: same immediate fully-evaluated raw FLAT escalation
same one-severity-step de-escalation after each fresh clear period
same post-initialization missing-data hold and counter reset
same complete-proof requirement for hard FLAT under partial missingness
market_state_transition_delta_from_v1.single_architecture_change: Remove the V1 current_state != FLAT exclusion from ordinary MARKET_STATE de-escalation. FLAT remains the highest market severity but is not absorbing in MARKET_STATE.
market_state_transition_delta_from_v1.flat_recovery_rule: When MARKET_STATE is FLAT and fully evaluated raw_index remains below FLAT for profile.deescalation_clear_days consecutive initialized dates, move exactly one severity step to DE_RISK_2 and reset both counters. Each subsequent lower market-state step requires a fresh profile.deescalation_clear_days streak. If raw candidate returns to FLAT before the clear period completes, reset the de-escalation counter and remain FLAT.
market_state_transition_delta_from_v1.permission_independence_rule: A MARKET_STATE transition away from FLAT has zero authority to change RISK_PERMISSION_LOCK.

required_v2_evidence: complete daily MARKET_STATE path for EARLY/BALANCED/CONSERVATIVE
exact raw-candidate/evidence-atom/normalization parity report versus immutable V1
all MARKET_STATE FLAT episodes with start date, end date, duration and first lower-state recovery date
state occupancy for every P5.1 event x profile x frozen evaluation bucket
first occurrence and signed anchor offset within each frozen P5.1 bucket
direct V1 versus V2 state-path comparison showing changes attributable only to removal of MARKET_STATE absorption
explicit assertion that RISK_PERMISSION_LOCK remains human-gated and is not inferred from MARKET_STATE recovery

architecture_pass_requires: the 2021-02-23 false raw FLAT remains present
MARKET_STATE is not structurally trapped forever by an earlier FLAT observation
later frozen P5.1 event windows remain observable/classifiable
no market-state recovery is treated as operational re-risk authorization

forbidden: modify or rerun immutable P5.3 V1 result
change P5.1 events, anchors or buckets
add or remove V1 runtime signal features
change V1 evidence atoms or raw candidate priority
change V1 percentile thresholds or normalization
hide, relabel or tune away the 2021-02-23 false raw FLAT
allow MARKET_STATE recovery to unlock operational risk
